Quality is conditional on each method’s native-success seeds; no CBBA/Auction quality exists at 80% and 90%. Compare matched subsets separately.
Voting pays reliable Commit; the others use native local/observer stopping. Radio model = Rady application delay + assumed 144 Mbps (NOT measured RF).
Illustration is a rounded, publication-only derivative of verified P2 4,000-case source; original run SVG and ZIP SHA preserved in provenance.
